name: Amazing PHRAE Marathon 2027
short_description: Amazing PHRAE Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 30 May 2027 at Kad Sam Wai, Phrae Town Municipality in Phrae, over 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Amazing PHRAE Marathon 2027 is organised by Route Map, with the event at Kad Sam Wai in Phrae Town Municipality. The Regis.run page lists four distances (5, 10, 21 and 42 km) and optional special finisher shirts for sub-1-hour 10 km and sub-2-hour 21 km runners. Bib collection is on 29 May 2027 from 12:00 to 18:00 at the same venue.

core_facts.venue: Kad Sam Wai, Phrae Town Municipality

faqs.question: How much does Amazing PHRAE Marathon 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: Early-bird prices (1 September to 30 November 2026) are THB 1,100 for the 42 km, THB 850 for the 21 km and THB 550 for the 10 km and 5 km. Regular prices apply from 1 December 2026 to 28 February 2027, at THB 1,200, THB 900 and THB 600.

faqs.question: What do Amazing PHRAE Marathon 2027 finishers receive?
faqs.answer: Runners in the 21 km and 42 km races who finish inside the cut-off receive one regular finisher shirt, collected at the venue. Runners who choose a special sub-challenge entry receive an extra shirt if they meet the target time.
